name: canonical_semantic_clusters_k7
description: Canonical 7-way semantic clustering of curated bitstring transformations, using semantic direction orbits and adding meta_constant manually to cluster 1.

parameters.orbit_distance: min_{a in O(f), b in O(g)} D(a, b)

cluster_selection.note: Elbow selected k=5, but k=7 was chosen as the canonical division after inspecting k=5 through k=8 because it produced the cleanest semantic taxonomy before the k=8 split introduced an awkward cross-cutting cluster.

manual_additions.manual_reason: Placed with context-dependent/global readout functions, especially xor_with_s0 and flip_bits+xor_with_s0.
